plugins.name: wechat
plugins.description: Connect an agent to your own WeChat Official Account and WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) via the official Tencent APIs: send text/Markdown and customer-service messages, look up follower profiles, create parametric QR codes and manage menus. Requires your own AppID/AppSecret. Unofficial, not affiliated with Tencent.
